description: A version the server keeps rejecting is probed a third time
old: ELSE IF version \in ModernVersions /\ version \in s /\ tried[version] = 1
new: ELSE IF version \in ModernVersions /\ version \in s /\ tried[version] >= 1

description: A server that answered like a modern one and then went quiet gets initialize
old:
/\ IF modernSeen /\ Legacy \notin advertised
          THEN Fail /\ UNCHANGED badFallback
          ELSE StartInitialize(modernSeen, advertised)

ModernRejection ==
    /\ pending = "discover"
    /\ modernSeen' = TRUE
    /\ Fail
    /\ UNCHANGED <<advertised, process, lastMeta, processEra, flipped, initializedSent, badFallback, earlyOp, unlisted>>
new:
ModernRejection ==
    /\ pending = "discover"
    /\ modernSeen' = TRUE
    /\ StartInitialize(TRUE, advertised)
    /\ UNCHANGED <<advertised, process, lastMeta, processEra, flipped, initializedSent, earlyOp, unlisted>>

description: initialize is accepted whatever version the server answers with
Operation requests go out while detection is still probing
Operation requests always carry the most preferred version, not the one chosen
old: MetaFor == IF state = "modern" THEN version ELSE "none"
new: MetaFor == IF state = "modern" THEN Preferred[1] ELSE "none"

description: A modern server that rejects every shared version mid-process is switched to initialize
old:
/\ lastMeta' = "unset" /\ UNCHANGED <<state, pending>>
          ELSE Fail /\ UNCHANGED lastMeta
new:
/\ lastMeta' = "unset" /\ UNCHANGED <<state, pending>>
          ELSE IF Legacy \in s THEN StartInitialize(TRUE, s) /\ UNCHANGED lastMeta
          ELSE Fail /\ UNCHANGED lastMeta

description: A probe to a server that went quiet after a modern answer never ends
old:
THEN Fail /\ UNCHANGED badFallback
          ELSE StartInitialize(modernSeen, advertised)

description: A server that doesn't implement discovery counts as having listed its versions
A server that doesn't implement discovery is served as legacy
